name: Card Scanner
description: Full-width stream of draggable cards that glide past a glowing vertical scanner beam, flipping each card into scrolling code text as it crosses, with particle effects around the beam.
contents: Endless horizontal stream of up to 5 gradient cards looped 3 times
Vertical scanner beam with particle canvas and a WebGL particle backdrop
Swipe hint label with animated arrows
behavior: Cards auto-scroll with decaying velocity down to a minimum speed
Drag, touch or wheel moves the stream and release keeps momentum
Card is clipped at the beam: front face on one side, generated code text on the other
Beam glow and particle density intensify while a card is crossing
editableByProps: Card content, gradient colors, size and spacing
Scanner color, width and particle counts
Speed, friction, code snippets, labels, fonts and background color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the maximum number of cards or loop repeats
Change the WebGL backdrop particle look
needsCodeEdit.where: createRadialGradient block and ShaderMaterial in the particle canvas useEffect

fixed: Sets body user-select and cursor while dragging and resets them on release and unmount
Captures wheel and touch events over the card stream, preventing default scrolling there
Canvases are sized to window width and listen to window resize
Loads Hanken Grotesk and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts
